rules.statement: A person who was not a party to the action can still apply to set aside a decree entered irregularly and be allowed to intervene, as long as it is shown that the decree does not bind them.
rules.supporting_quote: "The appellant, who was not a party to the partition action and did not know of it until after the final decree, applied in the District Court that the decree be set aside and that he should be allowed to intervene and prove his claim to an interest in the land."
